bottom-right spawn. }} [[Optimus Caliph]] was one of the [[Mursaat]] present at [[the Rise of the White Mantle]]. He assisted [[Saul D'Alessio]] in the defense of [[Kryta]] against the [[Charr]] invasion. Caliph was killed at [[Abaddon's Mouth]] in defense of the [[Door of Komalie]]. == Missions == * [[Ring of Fire Islands]] ** {{NPC location|Abaddon's Mouth}} * [[Kryta]] ** {{NPC location|The Rise of the White Mantle}} == Skills == * {{Skill icon|Aura of Restoration}} * {{Skill icon|Chain Lightning}} * {{Skill icon|Enervating Charge}} * {{Skill icon|Glyph of Concentration}} * {{Skill icon|Thunderclap}} ([[elite]]) * {{monster skill icon|Spectral Agony}} == Dialogue == : ''Yes, my blessed child. What do you need?'' == Items dropped == * [[Mursaat Garments]] * [[Mursaat Token]] == Notes == * Optimus shares his spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with [[Cairn the Destroyer]], [[Cairn the Relentless]], [[Mercia the Smug]], [[Sarlic the Judge]], and [[Willa the Unpleasant]]. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Optimus. * As his name translates to "highest ruler" (as described below) and because he acts as the leader of [[Mercia the Smug]] and [[Lazarus the Dire]] in [[Rise of the White Mantle]], it is possible he is the leader of the Mursaat. == Trivia == {{gw2w}} * ''"Optimus"'' means ''"highest"'' in Latin and ''"caliph"'' is the Romanised form of the Arabic word ''"khalifah"'', which means ''"successor"'' or ''"representative"'' and was used to describe the leader of the Muslim nation. Thus, Optimus Caliph roughly translates to ''"highest successor"'', ''"highest representative"'' or ''"highest ruler"''.
